notes.title: Day 3: We Leveled UP (Update 0.9.9)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31028986/156181e291a2073cbd40465aa083249083fe8a35.jpg[/img]

Hi survivors,

Over the holidays we were not idle and prepared a special update for you. Check it out!

[h1]Reworked Survivor Information[/h1]

We redesigned the healthbar and ammo indicators of the survivors. It looks like this now.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31028986/138c0b7c3e51097257def365e945bbd46c7f2114.png[/img]

You might be wondering what these new stars mean. And with this we come to our next new feature.


[h1]Survivor Level Up System[/h1]

Your survivors now earn xp when they kill zombies. With enough xp they level up.
This grants them more max hp and increases their stats overall. They also heal to full health, this can also make the difference in heated combat situations.
When they reach the maximum level of 10 they gain one of (currently) five different talents. They greatly boost their capabilities and you should make sure to keep them alive.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31028986/781b1b979802f388563571c2bad1c511acc24d06.gif[/img]

[b]Damage Talent[/b] This skill doubles the damage a survivor deals in melee and ranged combat. With this even the toughes zombies are no problem.

[b]Healer Talent[/b] This gives your survivor the ability to heal  himself and the others around him by a small amount. This could make the difference between life and death.

[b]Looter Talent[/b] A Survivor with this skill collects double the scrap and parts he normally would. This will give your resources a huge boost.

[b]Ammo Talent[/b] With this your survivor keeps giving out ammunition to himself and others. 

[b]Mine Talent[/b] This skill lets your survivor places mines randomly. They will explode when a zombie steps on it or after a short amount of time.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31028986/18bc8627cc655015bb88219c1b1f113476577760.gif[/img]

We also added 2 new special abilities that help with leveling your characters. Find them by opening crates.

[h1]Difficulty System[/h1]

But this is not all. We have also implemented a new difficulty system. You start the game only with "Easy" unlocked. You will unlock higher difficulties by increasing your player level while playing.

These difficulties influence the strength and spawnrate of zombies. But they will also increase the loot you find. So playing on these higher difficulties is much more rewarding. 

But keep in mind you probably need to upgrade your base first before tackling these new difficulties.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31028986/26fb9e8dec70e0973a1cb87ea8df91b222a25d93.png[/img]

[h1]Improved combat animations[/h1]

The survivor now will face where they are going. In addition they will now actually aim their weapons in the direction of the enemy and guns have also recoils.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31028986/0def3b38ba3178f4340ac6a0c10866771a0fce65.gif[/img]

[h1]Improved looting[/h1]

A few patches ago we added searchable containers (like cars) for the player to loot. Now your survivors will help you loot them.
And depending on your difficulty settings more containers will contain loot.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31028986/c3c6898a1388213655af4cec1f5506714a3843bb.gif[/img]

[h1]Changed camera controls[/h1]
[b]Important for everyone who already played the game.[/b] The camera mouse control is now by right click (instead of left click). We did this to avoid using usables by accident when moving the camera.

[h1]Many small fixes and changes[/h1]

Some of them are:
[list]
[*] Improved randomization logic. We now make sure rare loot spawns and events will reguraly show up.
[*] Crate screen only shows up if you can open a crate (thanks to VeTaL)
[*] Display ability cost in red when you do not have enough tokens to use them.
[*] Fixed survivors blocking each other from picking up the same loot.
[*] Added more types of truck convois.
[*] Rebalanced upgrade costs.
[*] Fixed tactic menu not displaying correctly sometimes.
[/list]

We hope you all enjoy the new patch. [b]If so, we'd appreciate any review![/b]

In any case, we are very interested in your feedback to help us make the game better. We are looking forward to it!

Also feel free to join our newly set up Discord here: https://discord.gg/4KCf5zt

- Your Deadly Days Team

notes.title: (Rainy) Day 1: Many, many zombies encountered (Update 0.9.7e)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31028986/278a0a5ece5c68e1974880e09e9a29b95da8d173.png[/img]

Hello survivors,

a week has passed and we have not been idle. The new version 0.9.7e is now available. We've made major changes to the game, triggered by feedback and Lets Plays. 

The primary complaint was that the survivors were not fighting actively and cleverly enough. But we also noticed that the start of our game was not engaging enough. We have now taken the first steps to resolve these problems.

[h1]Survivor now fight against only one target[/h1]
Previously, the Survivor melee attacks were carried out against all in enemies in a range. That looked strange and didn't feel right. With the new changes, survivors face zombies 1on1 and fight their way through hordes one after another. The zombies got the same change to maintain the balance.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31028986/9e6808e21209eb3cec4bd44fa7e9b0519adadcc0.gif[/img]

Furthermore, the ranged combat behavior was optimized, so that the survivors are much more willing to fight (especially against groups of zombies).

[h1]Zombies, we need more zombies.[/h1]
In the previous version, the map always felt a little empty. In later days there was a bit more going on, but especially the early game was a bit boring. 

Now we have drastically increased the number of active zombies. In addition, we have rebalanced the game so that most of the zombies are very weak and can be killed very easily. Now fighting the masses feels great! But be careful: they are still deadly in large groups. As the days continue to advance, opponents with new special abilites and stronger then ever appear, beware!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31028986/02ca31e1f8548d55c5a435b05399aa483939f55c.gif[/img]

[h1]New special abilities[/h1]
We added two new useful special abilites.

[b]Time Stop[/b] Take the stress out of a day, get an overview and optimize the current state of the game (e. g. give all weapons and heal them). 
All this by stopping the time for a few moments.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31028986/fe2d45fe50c4c4b69b64d5136eaa843cb9b153c6.gif[/img]

[b]Loot Scan[/b] Lots of lootable parts are not always clearly visible in the hustle and bustle. 
In this case, you can activate the Loot Scan to quickly highlight and collect all the loot around.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31028986/56f37de88d2a1148a2efb647e4e0a8ea5ccf1507.gif[/img]

[h1]Weather system[/h1]
We plan to visually polish the game a bit over the next few weeks. 
A first step for atmosphere is a weather system, which (currently) randomly activates a weather. 
Currently we have implemented two weather types, see for yourself.

[b]Rain storm[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31028986/d2b44237b2152a3abb6a7320adb9c0e240047660.gif[/img]

[b]Snow[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31028986/f1fd53a1ad987859ed746fcbcd75f10348d3871a.gif[/img]

[h1]Lootable environment[/h1]
Until now, scrap and parts could only be collected openly from the street. 
But now some of them are also hiding in cars and garbage cans. Keep your eyes open!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31028986/f64f626e619b6b2bbd7036885c7201d5bff24a07.gif[/img]

We think the game has improved a lot and is now much more enjoyable. We hope you like it too, let us know your opinion. We need your feedback!

Now have fun with the new version!

Your Deadly Days Team

notes.title: Welcome survivors!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

we are glad you found your way here! We have just released our Steam page and would like to take this opportunity to share some information about the current plan with you.

We are currently working on the following tasks:

[h1]Objective System[/h1] 
As you play, you'll get different tasks to complete. You can collect additional rewards and become even stronger. We are currently adapting the system in such a way that short-, medium- and long-term goals are always available. We are also working on the creation of further objective types.

[h1]More Events[/h1]
We have implemented a system for events so that rounds occasionally get quite different. Currently the system is filled with 5 different types (e. g. Zombie Horde), but that's not enough for us. Here we definitely want to generate more content to make event rounds as varied as possible. We have some ideas, but of course it would be interesting for us what you would consider an interesting event. Feel free to post your suggestions in the comments!

[h1]Tutorial[/h1]
In the Alpha-Test we found out that some players are a little overwhelmed at first when it comes to the game loop and the target. Here we definitely want to implement an initial tutorial until the Early Access Start. What is the most important thing for you in a tutorial and what do you not want to see?


We plan to make the first Early Access version available mid/end of November. We would be happy if you follow us on the way of creating a great game with and for you.

Also Follow us on Steam to get the latest updates on our development progress.

- Your Pixelsplit Team
